props.name: autoStartCooldownMs
props.description: The time `useAutoStartTour` keeps between tours, in milliseconds: a tour waits this long after the user last saw a step of another tour, in this visit or an earlier one.

props.name: initialRecords
props.description: Records a server already read, so a finished tour answers its status from the first render and the server HTML matches. Read them from the tour cookie in a Server Component: `initialRecords={parseTourCookie((await cookies()).get(TOUR_COOKIE_NAME)?.value)}`. Keep the cookie current from `storage`: a `write` that also passes `serializeTourCookie(records)` to a Server Action, which sets the cookie under `TOUR_COOKIE_NAME`.

props.name: onError

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null) | undefined
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the popover is closed. - `false`: Do not move focus. - `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (trigger or previously focused element). - `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element. - `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`). Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, `null` to fall back to the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((openType: InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null) | undefined
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the popover is opened. By default, focus moves to the first tabbable element inside the popup, except when the popover is opened by touch — then the popup itself is focused to avoid opening the virtual keyboard. - `false`: Do not move focus. - `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (first tabbable element or popup). - `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element. - `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`). Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, `null` to fall back to the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the popup holds focus and blocks the page. Leave it `false` for a coachmark, which keeps the page usable: a press outside the popup and focus leaving it do not end the run. Pass `"trap-focus"` with a `Tour.Spotlight`, and put a `Tour.Close` in the popup, so Base UI holds focus in the popup while the dim blocks the page.
